heading: About
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer currently studying at Epitech with a strong interest in backend development, cloud infrastructure and scalable systems.

Alongside my studies, I enjoy building software and exploring new technologies through personal projects. I'm always looking for opportunities to deepen my technical skills and turn ideas into practical, production-ready applications.
I particularly enjoy designing clean architectures, building reliable APIs and creating software that is maintainable, scalable and built to last.
